notes: Accessed via direct HTTP (curl) - robots.txt gives ClaudeBot an explicit 'Allow: /' (only /checkout,/cart,/login,/account,/orders,/payment disallowed), so Tier 1 HTTP was fully usable; no Playwright/Chrome needed. Site is a Next.js app; SSR pages embed a __NEXT_DATA__ JSON blob with the CMS page structure plus, on category (PLP) pages, the live product-search API response including exact facet counts - used this as the structured-data source per the qty priority order. Route to HomeStop: header nav item 'HOMESTOP' -> /category/Homestop, whose CMS page (id 186, pageName 'BAU homestop') lists the complete Home department L2 taxonomy via its own seo.l2categoryjson: Bedding (/home-bedding/c-1117), Living (/home-living/c-1120), Dining (/home-dining/c-1284), Kitchen (/home-kitchen/c-1372), Bath & Laundry (/home-bath-laundry/c-1419), Home & Kitchen Appliances (/home-home-kitchen-appliances/c-1451), Decor (/home-decor/c-1474), Pet Care (/home-pet-care/c-2592), Music Collections (/home-music-collections/c-2613). Fetched each L2 PLP and read its categoryPath3_uFilter facet (the site's own Sub-Categories facet, with exact per-value product counts) to enumerate every L3 node under Home: Decor -> Fragrance Candles and Holders, Vases & Flowers, Garden, Idols & Figurines, Wall Decor, Decor Accents, Lamps; Living -> Curtains, Cushions Covers & Fillers, Floor Coverings, Cushions, Ottomans, Dining Table Cover; Kitchen -> Storage Solution, Cookware & Bakeware, Food Preps & Tools, Table & Kitchen Linens; Dining -> Drinkware, Tea & Coffee, Dinnerware, Cutlery, Serveware, Table Tops, Table Linens; Bedding -> Bed Sheets, Quilts Comforters & Dohars, Pillows, Covers & Protectors; Bath & Laundry -> Towels, Bath Accessories, Laundry; Home & Kitchen Appliances -> Kitchen Appliances, Home Appliances. Also checked the Decor page's pro_type_uFilter (finer product-type facet): Showpieces, Potted Arrangements, Candles, Candle Holders, Artificial Flowers, Reed Diffusers, Table Vases, Aroma Oils, Lanterns, Electrical Diffusers, Oil Diffusers, Incense Sticks & Cones, Paintings, Potpourris, Wall Decors, Floor Vases, Table Lamps. None of this taxonomy (L2, L3, or product-type facet) contains a Diwali, Christmas, Halloween, New Year, Holi, Raksha Bandhan/Rakhi, Eid, Navratri, Valentine's, Easter, Thanksgiving, Mother's Day/Father's Day, or any other holiday/festival-named category or grouping node anywhere under Home. Paid particular attention to Diwali per the task brief: no Diwali/Deepavali node exists under Decor, Living, Kitchen, Dining, or any other Home L2/L3; 'Idols & Figurines' and 'Fragrance Candles and Holders>Candles' are generic year-round product types, not festival-specific categories (seasonal-product-type != seasonal-category, per rules SS5). Cross-checked with internal site search (not proof of absence per the rules, but useful for discovery, and robots.txt's Disallow:/search targets generic bots under User-agent:* - the ClaudeBot-specific block above it explicitly allows /search) for diwali, christmas, new-year, holi, rakhi, festive: each returned real (non-zero) results, ruling out the false-absence trap of a default/flat search response - diwali (6 products, all under Home>Decor>Fragrance Candles and Holders, i.e. plain candles/fragrance items tagged with the word 'diwali', not a Diwali category), christmas (4 products, all Women's silver jewellery, unrelated to Home), new-year (1 product, a Women's sling bag, unrelated to Home), holi (3 products, Beauty/Kids apparel, unrelated to Home), rakhi (166 products, all Beauty/Men/Women jewellery & personal care, none under Home), festive (3396 products, exclusively Men/Women/Kids ethnic apparel - Kurtas, Lehengas, Nehru Jackets, etc. - none under Home). None of these searches surfaces a Home-department seasonal PLP; the matches are ordinary year-round SKUs whose title/tags happen to include the search term, or apparel entirely outside the Home scope for this extraction. Attempted the category and landing-page XML sitemaps (api-ssl.shoppersstop.com/sitemap-categorypages.xml, sitemap-landingpages.xml) as a supplementary discovery channel but both returned HTTP 503 from a WAF/bot-protection layer on that subdomain (not a robots.txt disallow); this did not block the investigation since the CMS L2 taxonomy plus per-category facet enumeration plus multi-term site search already gave complete, mutually-corroborating coverage of the Home department's real category tree. Conclusion: HomeStop (Shoppers Stop's Home department) has no genuine seasonal/holiday category anywhere in its taxonomy - status NO_SEASONAL, rows empty.
